status: one-leg prescribed-pose kinematic/envelope screen; no timesteps or whole-body balance
limits: Only cylindrical motor envelopes and a rectangular foot are checked; visual link capsules are excluded. Screws, brackets, cables, housing cut-outs and other limbs are not modeled.
A fixed mount and prescribed poses are used. No simulation timesteps, controller or whole-body balance validation.
The joint-sway axis changes world orientation as the body pitches; this is a candidate axis arrangement, not a conventional quadruped hip assertion.
Vertical-force Jacobian calculations omit leg weight, inertia, horizontal force and contact-feasibility constraints.
This joint-mounted integrated-actuator layout is a comparison baseline. Remote knee/ankle transmission is not designed.

force_examples.scope: Only actuator contribution balancing the specified vertical force at sole centre; omits gravity of this leg, all inertia, horizontal forces and balance feasibility.
